title: Redesign homepage into a clean, futuristic landing experience

requirements.text: Redesign the public homepage (route "/") to feel like a clean, futuristic, user-friendly landing page rather than a basic dashboard-style page, while keeping the overall app navigation and authentication flow intact.

quotes: Make the homepage more user friendly like instead of a straight order dashboard like a just a better more appealing website

acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated, visiting "/" shows a modern landing page with clear hierarchy (hero, supporting sections) and obvious primary call-to-action.
The landing page is responsive (mobile → desktop) and maintains good spacing/typography with a clean, futuristic look.
All user-facing text on the landing page is in English.
No backend changes are required for the homepage redesign.

requirements.text: Update the existing LandingPage implementation to include additional landing-page sections beyond the current hero + 4-step grid, such as a benefits/features section and a clear next-step section that directs users to sign in (and/or sign up) using Internet Identity.

quotes: Make the homepage more user friendly... just a better more appealing website

acceptanceCriteria: LandingPage includes at least: (1) an improved hero section, (2) a benefits/features section, and (3) a prominent CTA section that routes to "/signin".
The CTA(s) use existing navigation patterns (TanStack Router navigate) and remain functional.
The new sections use existing UI components (e.g., Card, Button) and match the clean/futuristic aesthetic.

requirements.text: Implement a consistent clean/futuristic visual theme for the homepage redesign (colors, typography, layout, subtle futuristic accents like grid lines/glow), aligned with the existing dark-mode default and current Tailwind token system.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage design uses a cohesive visual system (consistent spacing, type scale, and accent usage) and does not introduce conflicting styles.
No changes are made to read-only UI component sources under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing components only).
The resulting page remains accessible (semantic headings, readable contrast, focus-visible states preserved).

requirements.text: Add a new generated static hero background image asset and use it on the homepage hero section as a subtle futuristic backdrop (do not serve it from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: A generated image file is added under frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced directly by the LandingPage hero section.
The hero background image loads in production builds without requiring any backend endpoints.
The background image remains subtle (does not reduce text readability) and scales well across viewport sizes.

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose only).
Keep the existing routing/auth behavior where authenticated users are redirected from "/" to "/dashboard" (or "/admin" for admins), unless explicitly required by the homepage redesign request.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Changing backend data models, order flows, or admin/dashboard functionality.
Introducing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity remains).
Building real-time features (e.g., live chat, WebSockets) as part of the homepage redesign.

required: Abstract clean futuristic grid/glow hero background, dark with subtle chrome accents (landing-hero-bg.dim_2400x1350.png)
